speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a chronic cough, weight loss, and generalized weakness. To understand the cause, how long has your cough been persisting?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: The constellation of fever, night sweats, weight loss, and chronic cough over six months is highly concerning for tuberculosis, especially given your recent incarceration. Do you have any known history of close contacts with active tuberculosis, or have you traveled to endemic areas?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Chronic cough and fever. I also have Weight loss, Night sweats, Generalized weakness, Poor appetite.
